blocks.x: A working definition of Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture for the enterprise: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.
This page covers Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture the way we deliver it: the pattern, the stack it runs on, the guards we ship and the artifacts your team holds at the first quarter close.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
